name: Tutorial · Animated screens
tagline: Logo title card, re-created app screens with cursor and fly-chips, caption pill, logo-video ending. Synced to voiceover.
recipe: Opening: TitleCard from src/tutorial/brand.tsx (animated LogoAnim, letter-spaced eyebrow "MagicBolt Tutorial", one gradient title, optional sub line). Nothing else on screen. Simple, clear, elegant.

Middle: fully animated re-creations of the app screens inside the Browser window from src/dns2/mock.tsx, centred at scale 1.06, on the soft Backdrop from src/dns/ui.tsx. No side rails. Only the bottom Caption pill (step badge + short text).
Interaction: animated Cursor with click keys, FlyChip for copy/paste, Toast for success, Pop/Words for callouts. Typing animates letter by letter.
Ending: EndLogo (plays public/logo-animation.mp4, 10.04 s, unedited) after the last sentence + 0.6 s.

Timing: copy the dns2/config.ts pattern. LINES = script, one sentence per entry. VO = measured sentence starts from the voiceover (transcribe it), estimated from word count (~2.5 words/s) until a recording exists. Every cue is F(n, x) = a point x (0-1) through sentence n.
First pass of a repeated task is slow and explained; repeats are quick passes with the same cue shape.
Privacy: never real DNS values or real account data; targets show as xxxx.dns.com, demo domain yourbrand.com, "Your Brand Agency".
Deliver a voiceover script (numbered lines + the same as one single-line paragraph) as SCRIPT.md in the project code folder.
